systems.system: South African School Administration and Management System (SA-SAMS)
systems.owner: Department of Basic Education, with the provincial education department and districts (named as those who should train its users)
systems.tiers: rural primary schools, Buffalo City Education District, Eastern Cape

note: Abstract only, and it never says what SA-SAMS records, so no class can be given from this document. It states that in rural primary schools of Buffalo City district, Eastern Cape, optimal use of SA-SAMS is held back by weak technological infrastructure, insufficient training and limited technical support (published December 2025).
